current_evidence.boundary: The accepted new-source f03-407-t100-final107-v2 comparison completed 858 strategy shards. On 54 independent Final accounts covering 107 days per arm, selected Hinf net PnL was −189.212148 USDC and ML-OFF −269.042233 USDC. Both lose money, and Final has previous use. The later five-candidate comparison uses a different frozen B0; all five candidates underperform its total and both unit net returns. Neither result identifies a pure cadence effect.
Read the original baseline, completed coverage, previous-use and limitations; this source does not resolve unrelated pending questions.
